title: How to configure ERP Integration Suite API credentials
body:
# Configuring ERP Integration Suite API Credentials

This guide walks you through updating the API credentials for the ERP Integration Suite.

## Prerequisites
- Admin access to the NHQ Connect portal
- New credentials from your WMS/ERP provider

## Steps
1. Navigate to **Settings > Integrations > ERP Connector**
2. Click **Edit Credentials**
3. Enter the new API key and secret
4. Click **Test Connection** to verify
5. Click **Save**

> **Note**: After saving, the connector will automatically retry any failed sync jobs from the past 24 hours.
description: Update ERP Integration Suite API credentials safely and verify the connection before saving.

title: Resolving journal entry mismatch errors in Analytics Engine
body:
# Resolving Journal Entry Mismatch Errors

Journal entry mismatches typically occur due to rounding differences or mismatched GL account mappings.

## Common Causes
- Foreign currency rounding differences
- Incorrect GL account mapping for exchange gain/loss
- Date filter spanning fiscal year boundary

## Resolution Steps
1. Go to **Settings > Chart of Accounts**
2. Verify the 'Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss' account is correctly mapped
3. Re-run the report with a narrower date range to isolate the issue
4. Use **Tools > Journal Reconciliation** to identify mismatched entries

If the issue persists, contact support with the reconciliation report export.
description: Diagnose and fix journal entry mismatch errors caused by rounding or GL account mapping issues.

title: Setting up 2FA for CRM Pro users
body:
# Setting Up Two-Factor Authentication in CRM Pro

## Enabling 2FA for your organization
1. Log in as an Organization Admin
2. Go to **Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication**
3. Toggle **Require 2FA for all users** to ON
4. Select your preferred method: Authenticator App (recommended), SMS, or Email OTP
5. Click **Save Policy**

## User enrollment
Users will be prompted to enroll on their next login. They will need to:
1. Download an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator)
2. Scan the QR code shown on screen
3. Enter the 6-digit code to verify enrollment

## Backup codes
Each user receives 10 single-use backup codes. Store these securely.
description: Enable and enforce two-factor authentication for every CRM Pro user in your organization.

title: Configuring overtime rules in HR & Payroll
body:
# Configuring Overtime Calculation Rules

Overtime rules in NHQ HR & Payroll are configured at the department level, allowing different multipliers for different employee groups.

## Accessing Department Settings
1. Navigate to **HR > Organization > Departments**
2. Select the department you want to configure
3. Click the **Payroll Rules** tab

## Overtime Multiplier Settings
- **Standard Overtime**: 1.5x (default for most departments)
- **Production/Manufacturing**: 2.0x (as per Bangladesh Labor Law)
- **Holiday Overtime**: 3.0x

## Important
Changes to overtime multipliers only affect payroll runs processed **after** the change is saved. They do not retroactively recalculate past payroll.
description: Define weekly and holiday overtime rules and how they interact with approval workflows.

title: Troubleshooting mobile barcode scanner on Android 14
body:
# Troubleshooting Mobile Barcode Scanner on Android 14

Android 14 introduced changes to camera permission handling that affect the NHQ Mobile Suite barcode scanner.

## Symptoms
- Scanner fails to initialize
- Blank camera preview
- App crashes on scan attempt

## Resolution
1. Update NHQ Mobile Suite to v3.2.1 or later (available on Play Store)
2. Grant 'Camera' permission explicitly: **Phone Settings > Apps > NHQ Mobile > Permissions > Camera > Allow**
3. If using a custom ROM, ensure Google Play Services is up to date

## Workaround (until update)
Use the **Manual Entry** button to enter barcodes/QR codes by typing them directly.
description: Fix Android barcode scanner pairing and input-mode problems in the warehouse mobile app.

title: API rate limit management for NHQ Connect
body:
# Managing API Rate Limits in NHQ Connect

This article explains how to configure NHQ Connect to gracefully handle third-party API rate limits.

## Understanding Rate Limits
Most third-party logistics and payment APIs impose rate limits (e.g., 100 requests/minute). NHQ Connect includes a built-in rate limit manager.

## Configuration
1. Go to **Connect > Connectors > [Your Connector] > Advanced Settings**
2. Set **Max Requests Per Minute** to stay within the API provider's limit
3. Enable **Automatic Retry** with exponential backoff
4. Set **Queue Priority** for time-sensitive operations

## Monitoring
The **Connect Dashboard** shows real-time API call volumes and rate limit proximity indicators.
description: Understand NHQ Connect API rate limits and implement retry strategies that avoid throttling.

title: Deploying the NHQ Agent with Docker
description: Step-by-step production deployment of the NHQ monitoring agent using Docker or Docker Compose.
body:
# Deploying the NHQ Agent with Docker

Run the NHQ monitoring agent as a container on any Linux host. This is the recommended deployment for production.

## Prerequisites

- Docker Engine **24+** and Docker Compose v2
- An agent token from **Settings > Agents > New Token**
- Outbound HTTPS (443) to `agent.nhq.example.com`

## Quick start

```bash
docker run -d --name nhq-agent \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -e NHQ_TOKEN="<your-token>" \
  -e NHQ_ENV=production \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro \
  nhq/agent:latest
```

## Docker Compose

```yaml
services:
  nhq-agent:
    image: nhq/agent:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      NHQ_TOKEN: ${NHQ_TOKEN}
      NHQ_ENV: production
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
```

## Configuration reference

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `NHQ_TOKEN` | Yes | — | Agent authentication token |
| `NHQ_ENV` | No | `production` | Environment label shown in dashboards |
| `NHQ_LOG_LEVEL` | No | `info` | `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` |
| `NHQ_PROXY_URL` | No | — | HTTP proxy for outbound traffic |

## Verify the deployment

- [x] Container shows `healthy` in `docker ps`
- [x] Agent appears under **Settings > Agents** within 2 minutes
- [ ] Optional: enable debug logs with `NHQ_LOG_LEVEL=debug`

> **Tip:** behind a corporate proxy, set `NHQ_PROXY_URL` and allow-list `agent.nhq.example.com:443`.

## Troubleshooting

```bash
# Follow agent logs
docker logs -f nhq-agent

# Common: token rejected (check for trailing whitespace)
docker exec nhq-agent nhq-agent verify-token
```

If the agent still fails to register, open a support case and attach the last 100 log lines.
